chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from 'Abdullah ibn 'Amir from 'Ali ibn Mahziyar from Fudaylah ibn Ayyub from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'In the Qunut of Friday prayer, if the Imam is leading, he performs Qunut in the first Rak'ah; and if he is praying four Rak'ahs, then [he performs it] in the second Rak'ah before the Ruku'.'
ai.seo_question: When should the Imam perform Qunut during Friday prayer according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the procedural variance in performing Qunut during Friday prayer based on whether the Imam leads a two-Rak'ah or four-Rak'ah prayer, a distinction rooted in the differing scholarly opinions regarding the length of Jumu'ah. It highlights the Imam's role in leading the supplication before Ruku', emphasizing the communal aspect of this specific du'a. This ruling is central to Shia fiqh regarding the completeness of the Friday prayer ritual.
